newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual fund redemptions 3.01 bln shekels.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual fund redemptions 3.01 bln shekels.

text.p: Net public redemptions from Israel's mutual funds in the first nine months of the year totalled 3.01 billion shekels, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report.
In the same period last year redemptions totalled 3.44 billion shekels.
The funds' net assets fell 19.8 percent from 16.10 billion shekels at the end of 1995 to 12.92 billion shekels at the end of September 1996.

The public has been redeeming money from mutual and provident funds (long term savings funds with tax benefits) because of their poor performances and investing much of the money in high-yielding savings accounts.
